description: Test suite for npm-resolution helper functions, verifying behavior of functions related to resolving npm package specifications, metadata mapping, record building, and logging.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for npm-resolution helpers.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Asserts that a value matches an expected value.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines an individual test case within the test suite.

methods.name: installedPluginRoot
methods.description: Helper to get plugin installation path from a root directory and plugin name.

methods.name: buildNpmInstallRecordFields
methods.description: Builds an install record object with npm package details.

methods.name: logPinnedNpmSpecMessages
methods.description: Logs warning and notice messages related to pinned npm specs.

methods.name: mapNpmResolutionMetadata
methods.description: Maps npm resolution metadata to a standardized install record format.

methods.name: resolvePinnedNpmInstallRecord
methods.description: Resolves and returns an npm install record for a pinned spec, with optional logging.

methods.name: resolvePinnedNpmInstallRecordForCli
methods.description: Resolves an npm install record for CLI use, with formatted warning output.

methods.name: resolvePinnedNpmSpec
methods.description: Resolves and returns the pinned npm spec with optional warnings.
